a.text: I'll honor our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, waiting until the reserve reaches 8 probably means neither of us survives. If you want to renegotiate, for example a fair way to decide who takes the current 4, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Until we both agree to a change, I'll stick to the plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If the generator runs, the reserve should hit 8, and next round I'll take exactly 4 as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
